sentences.text:
Gautam Sainy vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:28165
 1 M
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajesh Kumar Gupta
 On The 6 th Of November, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 50652 of 2025
 Gautam Sainy
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Anand Purohit - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Harish Sharma - Pp for the State.
ORDER Heard on I.A. No. 23250/2025 which is an application for ignoring the default.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that name of father of the present applicant has been wrongly mentioned in the cause title.
The correct name is Joharilal but it has been wrongly mentioned as Rakesh Saini.
Therefore, the same be ignored and the name of father of the applicant be read as Joharilal in the cause title.
Considering the submissions, the I.A. No. 23250/2025 is allowed and it is directed that name of father of the applicant be read as Joharilal in the cause title.

This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of interim bail relating to Crime No.66/2024 registered at Police Station - Ambah, District - Morena (M.P.) for the offence under NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:28165 2 MCRC-50652-2025 Sections 307, 354, 376(d), 376(2) (d) and Section 302 of IPC.
Verification report has been received.
Learned counsel for the applicant / accused argued that the mother of the applicant has expired on 28.10.2025 and her thirteenth day rights are scheduled to be held of 08.11.2025.
Being her son, the applicant is required to be present there.
Hence, he prayed to release the applicant on interim bail for the period of 15 days.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
However, he fairly admitted that factum of death and thirteenth day right has been verified and the same is scheduled to be held of 08.11.2025.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

In view of the documents filed by the applicant, present application is allowed and it is directed that applicant be released on temporary bail for a period of fifteen days i.e. till 21.11.2025 on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Applicant is directed to surrender before the trial Court/Committal Court on or before 21.11.2025.
During the period of temporary bail, applicant is directed not to visit in the vicinity of the prosecution witnesses related to this case.
The court below concerned is directed to submit the surrender report of the applicant to this Registry.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:28165 3 MCRC-50652-2025
If the applicant fails to surrender on or before 21.11.2025, Office is directed to place the matter before this Court under the head "direction matters".
With the aforesaid, this bail application stands allowed and disposed of.
C.c. today.

(RAJESH KUMAR GUPTA ) JUDGE Vishal Gautam Sainy vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42916819/
